item.title: Local Cllr plays down speculation that IPAS centre could open in Drumshanbo
item.description: A local councillor has played down speculation that an IPAS centre could be set to open in Drumshanbo. Letters outlining plans to open a centre in the town were sent out to local residents in recent days. A query was submitted to Leitrim County Council regarding the use of a former hostel as refugee accommodation last year. However, local councillor Enda McGloin says that has now been withdrawn. item.title: Man charged with assault in Ballaghaderreen released on bail
item.description: The Ukrainian national accused of a serious assault in Ballaghderreen, which led to the death of another man, has been released on bail. Yevhen Shutko (46) was charged with assault causing serious harm to Jordon Nevin on New Year's Day. item.title: Over 350 patients waiting over 18 months for treatment at local hospitals
item.description: Over 350 patients are waiting over 18 months for treatment at local hospitals. The most recent report from the National Treatment Purchase Fund reveals just over 5,000 inpatients were on the waiting list as of the end of December. A total of 5,186 are languishing on outpatient waiting lists at Sligo, Roscommon, Portiuncula and Mullingar hospitals. Advertisement As of the 31st of December, this number included 222 children. item.title: Local Green Party Rep calls for upgrade of rural transport system
item.description: A local Green Party representative is calling for an upgrade of our rural transport system, which he says has 'not changed since Victorian times.' Leslie O'Hora made the comments following a negative experience on Expressway's Sligo-Dublin bus. Speaking on the Joe Finnegan Show today, he explained there were broken seats on the Route 23 bus when he used the service last week, and the toilets were out of order. item.title: Information session to take place over proposed new Men's Shed in Ballymahon
item.description: An information session is set to take place next week over a proposed new Men's Shed in Co. Longford. Longford County Council recently held a meeting about the UrImpact project in Ballymahon, during which the need for a Men's Shed was identified. Men's sheds allow men of all ages and backgrounds to come together and participate in tailored activities and workshops. item.title: New 72-room hostel planned for Carrick gets the green light
item.description: A new 72-room hostel planned for Carrick on Shannon has been given the green light. Goldpine Partnership applied to Leitrim County Council last year to develop the hostel at Flynn's Field in the town. Over 240 guests are set to be accommodated in the new hostel planned for Carrick. The development is set to consist of a 3-storey mixed-use building comprising of 72 rooms, hostel reception, café, staff facilities, admin office, linen store, toilets, and service areas including bin and bike storage

item.title: Status Yellow wind warning issued for Leitrim this weekend
item.description: A status yellow wind warning has been issued for Leitrim this weekend. The alert is in place from 4pm until 10pm on Sunday. item.title: Traffic management plan confirmed ahead of anti-Mercosur protest in Athlone
item.description: Significant traffic in Athlone and surrounding areas is expected ahead of a protest tomorrow in opposition to the Mercosur trade deal. An Garda Síochána is advising motorists a traffic management plan will be in place. More than a thousand tractors and lorries have already pre-registered for the protest taking place in Athlone tomorrow at 11am.
